# IMPOSSIBLE: Set brightness on store room light (no brightness control available)

class EnsureLightOn(py_trees.behaviour.Behaviour):
    def __init__(self, name, state_url, action_url):
        super().__init__(name)
        self.state_url = state_url
        self.action_url = action_url

    def update(self):
        # Check current state
        resp = http_client.get(self.state_url)
        if resp.status_code == 200 and resp.json() == "on":
            return Status.SUCCESS  # Already on

        # Turn it on
        resp = http_client.post(self.action_url)
        return Status.SUCCESS if resp.status_code == 200 else Status.FAILURE

# Create the behavior tree
turn_on_light = EnsureLightOn(
    "Turn On Store Room Light",
    "http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home96/store_room/artifacts/storeRoomLight/properties/state",
    "http://localhost:8080/workspaces/home96/store_room/artifacts/storeRoomLight/turn_on"
)

# Since setting brightness is impossible, we only ensure the light is on
tree = py_trees.composites.Sequence(name="Ensure Light On Sequence", memory=True, children=[turn_on_light])
